statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ T D : ℕ, 2≤T → (∑ d ∈ (Finset.Icc 3 D).filter (fun d => Odd d ∧ (∀ p ∈ d.primeFactors, d.factorization p ≤ 1) ∧ T < orderOf (2 : ZMod d)), 1/((d:ℝ)*(orderOf (2 : ZMod d):ℝ))) ≤ C*Real.log (2*(T:ℝ))/(T:ℝ)
